subject: mathematics
concept: Finding a percentage of a whole number quantity
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore Model Method (bar modeling) principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student divides a virtual group of objects into hundredths-style portions to find a percent of the total
exercise.pictorial: Student uses a bar model divided into 100 parts to find a percent of a quantity
exercise.abstract: Student calculates a given percentage of a whole number amount

misconception_flags: divides by 100 but forgets to then multiply by the whole quantity, or vice versa

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
